title: Counter Hate Speech in Social Media: A Survey

bias_targets.methodology: Comparing toxicity scores generated by models (e.g., Google Jigsaw Conversation AI) on sentences containing female/women identifiers versus male/men identifiers to identify algorithmic bias caused by imbalanced training data, as well as evaluating how the gender of operators and annotators affects the preference and production of counter-narrative texts.
Qualitative content analysis of user comments on YouTube videos to evaluate stereotypical representations and the generation of biased opinions towards Islam and Muslims.
